objective: Infer compact executable musical relationships through the existing exact Rust codec; preserve observations while recovering useful harmony, voice-leading, rhythm and reusable structure.

checkpoint.summary: The exact Rust codec separates realized palettes from witnessed functional-root proposals. Shipped Mozart K330-I/K331-I strict joint root/core agreement remains 63.04% / 55.93%. The pinned RNBert comparator with shared development-selected 0.01 onset threshold, lowest-window bass, predicted-tonic scope and explicitly recorded next-chord dependencies reaches 91.89% / 90.42% joint, 98.14% / 97.77% root and 92.49% / 90.79% realized core. It has known Mozart training overlap and is not shipped inference or independent validation. The requested 100% remains unmet. Observations and strict denominators stay fixed; abstentions and uncovered tails remain errors; no holdout is parsed.
nextActions: Close realized-core and boundary errors jointly. Current learned windows cap joint agreement at 95.25% / 97.26% even under an unconstrained retrospective label oracle; actual labels lose another 14 / 56 quarters. All supported reference boundaries fit the upstream 1/16-quarter grid, so selected boundaries rather than quantization cause this ceiling. Preserve strict denominator and distinguish diagnostic oracles from predictions.

Audit the published training-target conversion and test one fixed cross-work realized-core residual scorer: train on K330 and infer K331, then reverse, with no target-work fitting or work/time fingerprints. Controlled transposition averaging and local role potentials do not beat the best pooled comparator. Packaged Mozart training labels omit minor/major sevenths even where the author source table has vi7; direct target adaptation is the next discriminating experiment.

Require continuity, independent seventh, ambiguity and track-repartition controls when changing scoring. Missing members can be implied by surrounding harmony; passing/neighbor motion can be structurally chordal. These musical distinctions constrain any learned or hand-written proposal.

Preserve an edited composition program independently of reanalysis. Keep source observations, authored parameters and inferred evidence distinct; a new inverse reading must not erase an authored dependency.
After representation/ranking choices are frozen, evaluate held-out work lineages once, alongside exact reconstruction, useful edits, runtime and explanatory cost.
